title_en: Is life better or worse in this digital era?
paras_en: Hi, my name is Billy and I am currently living in South Africa. My question today is life better or worse in this digital era?

Okay, so one thing is we sure life is better because you're able to watch this video and I'm able to make this video for you to watch. So I would say life is great with that. However, I would say that it actually depends because although life is supposedly increasing with the amount of technology that we are exposed to right now, I think the quality of life has decreased. There's a lot of people that are digitally connected or digitally informed.

However, quality wise, the quality of their friendship, the quality of their connections, or even just the quality of the entertainment that they are exposed to or their watch has decreased to a severe level. Although life is better because I can call you at any time and you can answer. I think that it's very hard for people to keep a quality of life that makes them happy and that makes them feel fulfilled.
What about you? Do you think life is better or worse in this digital era? I'd like to hear from you.

title_en: One Minute English B2-17 Would you ever get plastic surgery?
paras_en: Hi, I'm Bo, and I'm from the Philippines. And I will be answering the question would you ever get plastic surgery?

I am open to the possibility of getting plastic surgery. If something makes you happy and confident, even if it involves enhancing something physically with the help of plastic surgery, then by all means, go for it. It is also inappropriate to go out there and judge people who have done it, because we don't know the actual reason of them having the surgery. They might have undergone surgery due to an existing problem with their face or skin, while some do it for enhancement. Whatever the reason is, everyone deserves respect, and it never hurts to respect other people.
Hi, I'm Stacy. I'm Australian, and I live in Scotland, and my question is, what is my favorite food?

Well, I have two sushi and chocolate, but not together. I love sushi. I love this restaurant that I go to in Edinburgh and it has the most amazing sushi. I like to get the rainbow roll, which is tuna and salmon and cucumber and avocado, but it's also the way that it's beautifully presented. There is such an artistry to making sushi, and I just appreciate everything that goes into it, and I savor every bite. I just want to eat more and more and more. I could sit there for hours and just eating little bits here and there. I just love it. Chocolate, I mean, who doesn't love chocolate? It's sweet. It's comfort food. It's lovely when you dip it into your tea or your coffee and it melts a little bit. I love chocolate on strawberries. If you haven't tried that, give it a try. It's delicious. I just love chocolate and I love sushi, and that's me, and that makes me so happy.

title_en: Beginner English - 19 - What social media apps have you stopped using and why?
paras_en: My name is Ahmed. I come from Egypt. And my question is, what social media apps have you stopped using and why?

So I have stopped using Instagram because it wastes a lot of my time. I already have YouTube for mindless scrolling, so I did not think I needed another source of distraction in my life. Especially with Instagram, it's very easy to get lost scrolling on your phone, and so I made the decision to completely get rid of it, which annoyed my girlfriend a bit because she likes to send me memes. But yeah, I stopped using Instagram and I, Hey, I would encourage you to do so as well, and I would really encourage you to reconsider your position on how much time you're spending on social media apps in general.

title_en: What do you do to manage stress?
paras_en: Hi, I'm Simon. I'm from the UK, and the question in front of me right now is what do you do to manage stress?

Well, one of the things that I like to do when I'm stressed is I like to get out into the great outdoors. I love hiking. I like walking up mountains, and I also love to fish. For me, one of the greatest ways to manage my own stress levels and to calm myself down is to go out into the great outdoors, to a lake or by the sea with my fishing rod and try and catch my dinner. There's nothing better when you're out there in any environment. It doesn't matter whether it's sunny or if it's raining, as long as I'm by myself and I can just be surrounded by nature and be close to water. Whether I catch fish or not is not important. It's just being out there. It does do miracles for my stress levels, and that's how I managed to bring my stress levels down is by going outside and fishing.

title_en: Beginner English - 21 - Who is a famous person that you would like to meet?
paras_en: My name is Ahmed. I come from Egypt, and my question is, who is a famous person that you would like to meet?

Now, this is very obvious to me, and it's a psychologist called Dr. Jordan Peterson. This professor of psychology has really helped me become the person that I am today. So I credit a lot of who I am as a person to his knowledge and to his being, whatever that means. Honestly, he affected my life in a very, very good way. He had a lot of insights that I was not aware of. He helped me push myself. He helped me become a better person for myself, for my spouse, for my family, for everyone around me, for society. I think he is a wonderful person as far as I know him to be, at least from what he communicates, from how he seems to be online, which I think is true.
So yeah, I would definitely, if I could meet anyone right now, it would definitely be him just to show him some appreciation for his work and how it affected my life.

title_en: Beginner English -22 - What product is in high demand?
paras_en: Hi, my name is Billy, and I will be talking today about what product is on high demand.

So this is a very interesting topic because I think products depends on who you're asking and also the gender. Like for example, for females, I think the highest product on demand right now is makeup or cosmetic materials. And you have so many brands. You have your Kylie Jenner brands, you have Fenty, I think by Rihanna. There's so many products that are on high demand, but I think the cosmetic industry is booming right now. So those products are going to be on higher demand. I think if you ask guys, the highest demand would probably be maybe a car or some, like yeah, a car with a V8 engine or something like that. Maybe a watch.

So I think it depends on the gender and also the age gap in which you're going for. But a product that I think will always be on high demand is food. Right now, I think we need more food than ever before, and it's the highest demand that we can get. So yeah, let's keep that product on lower demand, make sure everybody has food to eat and such.
So yeah, that's my take.

title_en: One Minute English Video #699 Have you ever been lost?
paras_en: Hello, my name is Bianca and I'm from North Carolina in the United States. My question is have you ever been
lost?
Have I ever been lost? Yes. I've been lost countless times even with the GPS, but thankfully today I am better
than I used to be because in the past, I would get on the metro going in the wrong direction, or I would walk in
circles and end up late to an appointment that I was supposed to be at.
Nowadays, because I know that I'm a person with a compromised sense of direction, I like to prepare
beforehand. So that means looking up the directions to a place and also giving myself a buffer of
time just in case I do get lost. Oftentimes for a very important event, I'll do a dry run of the route
the day before. So I will look up the directions and I will take them the day before to make sure I know what
I'm doing and where I'm going the day of and I don't arrive late.
Again, generally I'm much better than I used to be. In the United States, being late is sort of frowned

upon, so I try to do everything I can to arrive on time or early. And it's also less stressful for me. If all else fails, then I will request an Uber or a Lyft. And I like to give buffer time for the driver
just in case he or she gets lost as well. But again, generally I am much better than I used to be. And that is
thanks to technology. So thank you so much. And what about you? Have you ever been lost.

title_en: Beginner English - 24 - Do you prefer shopping at a mall or online?
paras_en: Hi, I'm Stacy. I am Australian and I live in Edinburgh. And my question is, if I prefer shopping in a shopping mall or online.

A hundred percent prefer shopping online. I will often have several shopping baskets open with things in it at a time just because I just love having a little wishlist of things I want to buy. I love the beauty that you can shop anytime, anywhere in your pajamas with a cup of tea, with your favorite TV show in the background. And I just love seeing what's out there. I have specific shops that I buy from most of the time, so I know what size I am, so I don't need to go in and try things on. I know that I'm a size whatever in this top, and I'll be a size or whatever in those jeans, and it's just simple and it's easy and it comes to you in a few days. You don't have to leave your house. I think it's great, and I love it, and I'm just so glad it's now a thing that we can do every day because it's just so easy.

title_en: High-Intermediate English - 25 - Where did you go for your last vacation?
paras_en: Hi, I'm Olivia. I'm from Washington DC and my question is, where did you go for your last vacation?

It was in what must have been May. We went to Spain. So I used to live right outside of Barcelona in a town called Sits, which is right on the coast. It's a beautiful little vacation town. So I lived there for three years and I wanted to go back and visit and, oh, hello cat, and show my boyfriend where I lived. So that was beautiful. We stayed there for about three days. Enjoyed the beach. It was sunny, but not too warm. And then we went to Madrid to visit my other two friends that I met while I was living in Spain, and spent about two and a half days with them, and it made my heart so happy to see them again. And then we went to Saville. I haven't been to Saville ever, and that was really exciting and that was fun because that was the part of the trip that I didn't plan. I left it up to him, so everything we did was kind of a surprise, and we spent about two days there. So yeah, my last holiday in Spain, I loved it very much and I am desperate to go back. So hopefully within the next couple of months I can book in a trip to go back, even if it's just a short one.

title_en: High-Intermediate English - 26 - Do you follow astrology?
paras_en: Hello, my name's Elaine. I'm from England. My question today do you follow astrology?

I read my horoscopes, not every day, maybe once or twice a week. Sometimes, I forget to read them completely, so they're not really that important to me, but I do read them. I read them usually when I'm a little bit uncertain about what to do with my life, or I have a decision to make. I'll find myself lingering over the horoscopes a little bit longer than normal. I know which star sign I am. I know which star sign my mum is, any potential friends are.

I feel like we can gain a little bit of insight into people's characters based on their star sign. Although, I don't take it too seriously. I think some people use horoscopes and astrology in the same way that they use religion. They need guidance and a connection to the universe, a bigger picture to understand where they're going in their lives, that give them some direction, just in the same way that other people use religion. So, it's different for everybody. What about you? Do you believe in astrology, or do you believe in something different?

title_en: High-Intermediate English - 27 - What is a city that you visited?
paras_en: Hi. My name is Bo. And I'm from the Philippines. And I'll be answering the question, what is a city you
visited not long ago?

The last city I visited was Shanghai in China. I've been to Shanghai twice already, and it always fascinates me. The city is very advanced when you talk about their infrastructure and their transportation system. Plus
it's very tourist-friendly. You can also go to Shanghai Disneyland if you are into theme parks.
One of
the things I look forward to when I go to Shanghai is the maglev train ride from the airport to the city.
Maglev stands for magnetic levitation. So the train is floating and it travels at a speed of 300 kilometers per
hour or
more, which would only take you about five minutes to get to the city. If you ever need a destination for
your
next trip, put Shanghai on the list.
